phrases.text: Your car takes up the whole garage.
So the lawnmower, the bikes and the tools need somewhere else. A shed.
You never put a shed straight on grass. Mark it out, and lift the turf.
Lay hardcore, and pack it down hard. Then sand, then paving slabs, perfectly level.
Timber bearers lift the floor off the slabs, so air flows underneath and the damp stays out.
Walls, a roof, and the tools go in.
But the lawnmower doesn't fit. So you build an extension on the side.
Then the bikes don't fit. So you add a room on top.
Then come the Christmas decorations. Another floor.
Then the camping gear, and the paddling pool. Another floor.
Carrying boxes up three flights of stairs is hard work. So you bolt a lift to the outside.
The lift needs power, so you put solar panels on the roof.
But next door's tree throws a shadow right across the panels. No sun, no power. The lift stops.
So you raise the roof above the tree. Two more floors, and the panels are back in the sun.
And those two empty floors? They fill up too.
Congratulations. Your car still has the whole garage. And you still can't find the screwdriver.
